ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field; approximately 92% dark-grey/black pixels vs 8% high-intensity white speckling/dots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey base with scattered high-intensity white punctate spots across both lobes. A distinct cluster of yellowish-tan pixels is localized at the distal tip of the right lobe (image right).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 50-60 degrees; deep central depression relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern; right lobe trailing edge displays sharper, higher-frequency peaks compared to the smoother, more rounded peaks on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave arc along the trailing edges tapering towards the distal tips; lobes exhibit an upward and outward sweep from the center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel diameter) distributed across the ventral surface, most concentrated on the mid-to-lower sections of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent yellowish-brown textured anomaly is visible on the extreme right distal tip, contrasting with the dark pigmentation of the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, raised yellowish-tan clusters are visible along the upper leading edge boundary of both lobes, suggesting localized organic attachments.
